Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full vehicle-configurator payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Build your electric SUV","model":"Electric SUV","currency":"USD","basePrice":41990,"colors":[{"id":"white","label":"Glacier White","hex":"#f3f4f6","priceDelta":0},{"id":"black","label":"Midnight Black","hex":"#111827"},{"id":"red","label":"Radiant Red","hex":"#dc2626","priceDelta":595,"selected":true}],"optionGroups":[{"id":"trim","label":"Trim","selectedId":"rs","options":[{"id":"lt","label":"LT","priceDelta":0},{"id":"rs","label":"RS","priceDelta":3200,"detail":"Sport-tuned"}]},{"id":"drive","label":"Drivetrain","selectedId":"awd","options":[{"id":"fwd","label":"FWD","priceDelta":0},{"id":"awd","label":"AWD","priceDelta":2500}]},{"id":"pkg","label":"Packages","selectedId":"tech","options":[{"id":"none","label":"None","priceDelta":0},{"id":"tech","label":"Technology Package","priceDelta":1800,"detail":"Adaptive cruise, HUD"}]}],"submitText":"Reserve this build","submitValue":"I'd like to reserve this configuration"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading. Defaults to 'Build your vehicle'.
- 'model' (string, optional): the model name shown under the title.
- 'currency' (string, optional): ISO code, default USD.
- 'basePrice' (number, optional): the starting price; the estimate builds up from here.
- 'colors' (array, optional): paint choices rendered as single-select circular swatches. Each { 'id' (string, REQUIRED); 'label' (string, REQUIRED — the color name); 'hex' (string, optional — a CSS color like '#dc2626' for the swatch); 'priceDelta' (number, optional — added to the estimate; default 0); 'selected' (boolean, optional — the default color) }.
- 'optionGroups' (array, REQUIRED unless colors are provided): each group { 'id' (string, REQUIRED); 'label' (string, REQUIRED — e.g. Trim, Drivetrain, Packages); 'selectedId' (string, optional — the default option; else the first option); 'options' (array, REQUIRED) of { 'id' (string, REQUIRED — sent back on selection); 'label' (string, REQUIRED); 'priceDelta' (number, optional — added to the estimate; 0 shows as 'Included'); 'detail' (string, optional — one short line) } }. Each group is single-select.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): confirm-button label; defaults to 'Reserve this build'.
- 'submitValue' (string, optional): a base message; the card appends the chosen color, options, and estimated price when sending back.

Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
